title: Argus team
description: A team of agents taking turns on one goal, directed by Argus (team.yaml). This checks the shape: keys, types, values. Argus checks the rest when it reads the file — arrows to steps that do not exist, a step that would restart itself for ever, conditions that can never fire. See https://github.com/andreaderuvo/argus/wiki/Teams

name.description: The team's name, shown on its card and its window. Its sessions are called <name>-<step>.

goal.description: What the team should get done, in words. Fills the goal box when the team is chosen.

gate.description: How much it goes on alone. ask: you press Continue at the end of each round. auto: goes on, stops at the second failed check in a row. goal: goes on until a judge says DONE or the rounds run out.

rounds.description: At most this many rounds (10 when left out). A round is one pass through the flow.

permissions.description: What the agents may do without asking — a suggestion the person sees before Start. ask: ask for everything. edit: edit files freely, ask for the rest. everything: no questions at all (--dangerously-skip-permissions).

start.description: The step(s) the team starts from. The first step when left out.

steps.description: The steps, by name: an agent (role, judge, duty…), a check (check: <command>) or a join (join: true). At most 12 steps and 8 agents. `done:` may be listed to keep an end nothing points at yet.

flow.description: The arrows, one per line: `a -> b`, `a -> b, c` (both start), `a -> b if PASS`, `a -> b if OK, REDO`, `a -> done if DONE`. Fan-in is one line per arrow (`a -> j` and `b -> j`). A check says PASS or FAIL; a judge says OK, REDO, DONE or BLOCKED; anyone may say BLOCKED.

reset.description: What "start this team again from clean" means — used by Reset and Restart, which show the exact list before touching anything. Without it nothing is deleted.

files.description: Paths or globs relative to the team's folder: the files that are a run's state (a ledger, positions, a journal). Never absolute, never `..`; .git, team.yaml and the log are never deleted.

run.description: A command run in the team's folder after the files are deleted (a login shell, ten minutes at most).

log.description: TEAM.argus.md: archive (renamed with the date — the default), keep, or clear (deleted).

stepName.description: A step's name: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at most 20 characters.

role.description: An agent step's role: planner, executor, reviewer, researcher, writer, critic, tester — or any word, with a duty.

judge.description: This agent ends its turn with a verdict: OK, REDO, DONE or BLOCKED. The arrows out of it carry those.

duty.description: Its job in your words — may name the agent's own skills ("use your /security-review skill").

worktree.description: Work in its own git checkout on a branch team/<team>-<step>, so parallel executors never collide.

reads.description: The step(s) whose worktree this one should look at.

check.description: This step is a check: a command run in the project; exit 0 is PASS. `true` leaves the command to be given at Start.

of.description: The agent whose work this check checks (the one pointing into it, when left out).

join.description: This step is a join: it waits for every arrow coming in.
